name: readiness
tagline: a one-week assessment of product, ai opportunity and governance maturity, with a plan you can act on monday.
forWho: product and transformation leaders who need an honest read before committing to a build or an ai programme.
included: a sixty-minute readout with your team
outcome: you will know what to build, what to govern first, and what not to touch yet. if the answer is "you do not need us," we say so.

name: product build
tagline: digital products and platforms shipped end to end: discovery, design, build and measurement.
forWho: teams who need a product in users' hands, not another prototype deck.
outcome: a product in production, with one primary metric and a team that knows how to keep shipping.

name: ai implementation
tagline: end-to-end ai delivery inside your governance: prioritise, prove, deploy, hand over.
forWho: organisations stuck between ai ambition and production reality, who need builders that respect existing controls.
included: use-case prioritisation and proof of concept
integration with your change and release process
outcome: ai that users touch every week, with an accountability trail your board can follow.

name: ai governance
tagline: governance foundations before your teams write a line of model code: frameworks that stand up to audit and board challenge.
forWho: regulated or programme-heavy organisations that cannot adopt ai by bypassing the controls that protect them.
included: eu ai act and uk framework alignment
outcome: controls your auditors can verify, and a path for delivery that does not fight them.

name: onboard
tagline: build the capability in, not bolt it on: training, operating model and handover that sticks.
forWho: teams who have been left with a system they cannot run, or who want the amplify phase done properly from day one.
included: centre of excellence setup where it earns its keep
outcome: your people can own, improve and explain the product without calling the agency every sprint.

monthlyDeliverables: a monthly readout on what moved
